title: Ticket
description: Support ticket or issue tracking record with customer information, assignee, priority, status, category, and resolution timestamps. Used for customer support systems, help desks, and issue tracking platforms.

ticket_number.description: Unique ticket reference number for customer tracking

description.description: Detailed description of the issue or request

customer_id.description: Foreign key reference to the customer who created the ticket

customer_email.description: Customer email address for ticket communications

assigned_to.description: Full name of the support agent assigned to handle this ticket

priority.description: Ticket priority level (e.g., low, medium, high, urgent)

status.description: Current ticket status (e.g., open, in_progress, waiting, resolved, closed)

category.description: Ticket category (e.g., technical, billing, feature_request, bug)

created_at.description: Timestamp when the ticket was created

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the ticket was last updated

resolved_at.description: Timestamp when the ticket was resolved, null if still open
